title: Reach the 42 unreached critical-tier mutants (TS-11 AC0 follow-up)

Aim first at the 42 UNREACHED mutants - those whose mutated line the corpus never executes (gate.py 33 of its 55 'equivalents'). Any slot request beyond the DEC-195 cap of 79 comes back with that number first.
